title: Design: Over limit badge looks as it does today
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure work order 1 is open, for a customer on Net 30 with a credit limit of $500.00 and a balance above it.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p9-01-an-invoice-today-net-30.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Under the work order number a red "Over Limit" pill shows beside the status badge, the same as today's picture ct-p9-01-an-invoice-today-net-30.png.

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

The PRD writes "Over limit"; today's badge reads "Over Limit" and the PRD keeps the existing badge (register CT-D07, settled).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-R2: “The "Over limit" badge on work orders and part sales follows the same rule as S9-R1.”
  • Story 9, Form factor: “Form factor: Mobile-optimized: no new screen; the existing confirmation and "Over limit" badge keep their existing mobile variants and only change when they appear.”
